issue.title: [inbox-pipeline 02/07] Configure and retire Inbox item types (#102)

body:
Relay BB run pushed an update.

Pull request: #260

Tokens: 0 · Cost: $0.0000

Pushed successfully.

Branch: `bb/relay-102-inbox-pipeline-02-07-configure-and-ret-thr_4ye2mqhn88`

Implements issue #102: adds `processingMethod` (`pageContent` | `database`) and `targetDatabase` to Inbox item types, with cross-field validation enforced in `inbox/inboxTypesStore.ts` (mirroring the existing date/time enforcement pattern in `inboxStore.ts`), a seed update for fresh installs, and an additive migration (`0010_inbox_type_processing.sql`) for the already-seeded database from issue #101. Also adds `deleteInboxTypeWithClient`, which dereferences the type from unlocked Inbox items on delete (routing them into the existing untyped/unknown-type path) while leaving locked (already-processed) items untouched — per the epic's "no special-case handling, reuse the existing unknown-type mechanism." 12 new/updated tests in `inboxPipeline.test.ts` cover validation, update-merge semantics, and delete/dereference behavior, all passing against the embedded Postgres test suite; `tsc --noEmit` is clean.
This issue was resolved by #260, which just merged into develop.
